prior_evidence: Gaia DR3 variability class S and AAVSO VSX type S, plus the ATLAS dubious-variable record J141.0252-22.1165 at 0.767802 d.
disposition: TESS and resolved ZTF g and r photometry identify the same star and two unequal minima. Their broad, smooth shape also permits rotational or ellipsoidal modulation. The available data support a probable eclipsing interpretation.

timing.interpretation: Half-period yields alternating depths in all three TESS sectors. Consecutive primary depths at the adopted period are consistent within each sector.

extraction: 13x13 TESScut. Quality zero and finite pixels. Source-centred 1.35-pixel-radius aperture with an edge-pixel background. Each minimum-light difference image uses adjacent baseline on both sides. Multistart Gaussian fits profile positive amplitude and additive background over position.

title: The SDSS-HET Survey of Kepler Eclipsing Binaries: Spectroscopic Dynamical Masses of the Kepler-16 Circumbinary Planet Hosts

smooth_double_wave_check.method: Unweighted least squares on published phase-bin medians, predicting every fifth populated bin from the other four fifths in turn.
